privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {legalName} (“AGXORA”, “we”, “us”) processes personal data when you visit {siteUrl}, create an account, or use the AGXORA platform.
privacy.dataAccount: Account data: name, email, organization, and role.
privacy.dataUsage: Usage data: product interactions, device, and diagnostic logs.
privacy.dataBilling: Billing data: plan, invoices, and payment references from providers.
privacy.dataSupport: Support communications you send to us.
privacy.purposesBody: We process data to provide the service (contract), secure the platform (legitimate interest), meet legal obligations, and—where required—with your consent (for example optional analytics or marketing).
privacy.retentionBody: CRM contacts, notes, and document metadata can be deleted in the product. Invoices, delivery notes, governed executions, and evidence are retained. This policy describes product behavior, not a separate legal retention schedule.
privacy.sharingBody: We use vetted processors (hosting, email, payments) under appropriate contracts. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.yourRightsBodyBefore: Signed-in organizations can download an export of their business data from Settings. CRM contacts, notes, and document metadata can be deleted. Invoices, delivery notes, executions, and evidence are retained. For other requests, contact
privacy.yourRightsBodyAfter: You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
privacy.cookiesBodyAfter: for details on essential and optional cookies.
privacy.dataBusiness: Organization records you enter: CRM customers, contacts, notes, document metadata, invoices, and delivery notes.
privacy.dataConnections: Connected accounts: when an organization connects YouTube, Gmail, or Instagram, AGXORA stores an account identifier and encrypted OAuth tokens for that connection. An Instagram connection also stores the Instagram username. When Instagram publishing is enabled and someone explicitly publishes, AGXORA sends one approved image and its caption to that Instagram account. AGXORA does not receive Instagram messages or insights. Facebook Pages connection is not available.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy describes how {companyName} uses cookies and similar technologies. Essential cookies are required for authentication and security. Optional analytics cookies are enabled only where consent is collected.
cookies.whatAreBody: Cookies are small files stored on your device. They help the site function, remember preferences, and—where allowed—measure performance.
cookies.essentialBody: authentication, security, load balancing, and basic preferences. Required for the service.
cookies.functionalBody: optional features such as remembered UI settings (when enabled).
cookies.analyticsBody: aggregate usage measurement (only with consent where required).
cookies.managingBody: You can control non-essential cookies through browser settings and, once available, our on-site preference center. Blocking essential cookies may prevent sign-in or core product use.

deletion.title: User data deletion
deletion.intro: This page explains how personal data in an AGXORA account can be deleted in the product or requested by email. Opening this page does not delete data. AGXORA does not provide an automated deletion callback for Meta or any other platform.
deletion.inProductBody: A signed-in organization can delete CRM contacts, notes, and document metadata. A customer record can be deleted only when no invoice or delivery note is attached. If financial documents are attached, deletion is refused and those documents remain.
deletion.retainedBody: Invoices, delivery notes, governed executions, and governed evidence are retained. This page does not confirm that a database backup exists, or that copies held in a backup are removed.
deletion.exportBody: A signed-in organization can download an export of its business data from Settings.
deletion.requestBefore: To ask AGXORA to delete an account, or personal data you cannot delete in the product, email
deletion.requestAfter: Include the account email and the organization name so the account can be identified.
deletion.connectedBody: A signed-in organization can disconnect YouTube, Gmail, or Instagram in the product when that connection exists. Disconnect clears the stored encrypted tokens and marks the connection revoked. The stored account identifier can remain on that connection record. Disconnect does not delete other organization records. Disconnecting Instagram does not remove a post already published on Instagram. This site has no Meta data-deletion callback and no Meta webhook.
